notes.title: Dozens more Achievements for you!
notes.notes:
Hello, pilots!

The second update of One Against The Galaxy is up with:

* 48 new Achievements! Use bombs, kill the enemy, and die a lot!
* Fixes to the interface effects as requested!
* Full-screen also as requested!
* A little extra balancing on the first couple of phases!

And how far are other players going, you ask?

So far only EIGHT players managed to reach Phase 5, and no one has lasted until Phase 6.

Who will be the one to break this record? You, maybe?

Then get to shooting! The Galaxy is waiting for you!
 - JMBeraldo

notes.title: First update ftw!
notes.notes:
Hello, pilots!

A quick update just went up. Other than a few minor bug fixes, it brings in Simplified Chinese localization for the whole game. Seems like the game is quickly becoming popular in China, with almost as many players as in the US, so, why not help our friends out there understand the game a little better?

I hope you enjoy it!

On the next update I'll check the volume of sound effects and music, tweak game balance for the mid phases and investigate a couple of bugs that came up.

Let me know if there is anything else you guys want to see in the game, and I'll accomodate it in my To Do list.

Thanks!
 - JMBeraldo
